secondaryMetric: GA4 outbound store-intent clicks from the page when measurable
successCriteria: At least 500 post-deployment impressions and page CTR of 0.6% or higher after the reporting lag, while preserving average position within the guardrail.
guardrails: Page remains indexable with HTTP 200 and its existing canonical URL
Average position does not decline by more than 2.0 positions
Comparison remains accurate and does not introduce unverified pricing or superiority claims
App Store and Google Play links remain valid

observationWindow.extensionReason: The shared production redesign deployed during the original window. Preserve the original evidence, quarantine the August 25 transition day, and require a homogeneous August 26–September 8 treatment window plus the existing reporting lag.

latestFinalizedEvidence.note: Finalized rows through August 23 exceed the 500-impression threshold, but CTR is below the 0.6% success criterion and the 14-day observation window is incomplete. Position remains materially better than baseline, so continue without changing the target page.

latestDirectionalPulse.note: August 24–25 rows are incomplete directional evidence. CTR is directionally above threshold and position remains inside the guardrail, but this pulse is not a winner decision and does not shorten the observation window.

lastCycleReview.note: Fresh Search Console and live production/indexing guardrails pass. Preserve the target page unchanged and use the extended 2026-09-12 gate because the shared redesign contaminated the original window.

treatmentContamination.change: A site-wide redesign changed the shared blog template and layout and changed this page's hero image while the experiment was active.

analyticsMeasurementBoundary.issue: Same-origin /download CTA clicks were not included in store-intent events, so the pre-repair secondary metric is a directional lower bound.
analyticsMeasurementBoundary.decision: Repair tracking immediately, keep the primary Search Console metric unchanged, and compare secondary store intent only after the repair deployment is timestamped.

rollback.condition: Rollback if a guardrail fails, or if at least 500 impressions accrue and CTR declines materially while average position declines by more than 2.0 positions.
rollback.action: Restore the previous title, description, H1, opening paragraphs, and TripCache table wording from this record.
